name: superb
description: Personal skill collection for Claude Code and Codex, invoked as superb:<skill>. setup installs what the others need; craft turns a vague product idea into a decision-rich brief; pipeline v2 drives a settled idea through approved file-backed plans and durable execution state to a finished branch; pipeline-auto does the same with one human gate, resolving later decisions by a three-agent quorum that may never overrule a recorded human answer; fast-pipeline trades tests and review layers for speed, with one spec approval and a final review/bug-fix loop; turbo-pipeline asks one batch of at most six questions and then builds autonomously, settling later decisions by two independent brains whose higher confidence wins; bug-investigate finds out why something is broken and stops there; bug-fix carries it on to a regression-tested fix.
